faq.q1: Do I need anything complicated to get started?
faq.a1: Nope. Just sign up and you can use it straight away in your browser. If you want the Desktop app, installation is quick too.
faq.q2: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.a2: Yes. Open the app in your phone's browser to check bookings, take payments and see revenue at any time.
faq.q3: I'm not tech-savvy. Can I still use it?
faq.a3: Yes. SalonGo is made for salon owners, not IT people. If you need help getting started, our team will support you.
faq.a4: Yes. Data is stored and backed up regularly. Customer and revenue information is always protected.
faq.q5: Am I locked into a contract?
faq.a5: No. Pay monthly or yearly and change plan or stop renewing right in the app. No hidden fees.
faq.a6: Yes. Each staff member is paid a percentage of their own revenue or a fixed monthly salary. The owner picks how tips are shared: to whoever the client tipped, or split equally. Payroll is totalled every period.
faq.q7: Is SalonGo for small or large salons?
faq.a7: Both. You can start small and upgrade as your salon grows.
faq.q8: Can I try before I decide?
faq.a8: Yes. Every new salon gets a free {days}-day trial with every feature, no card needed.
faq.a9: We reply within 24 hours, in Vietnamese and Czech. You won't be left on your own.
faq.closingParagraph: Still unsure? The best way is to try it and see for yourself before deciding.
faq.noResults: No questions match. Try different keywords or contact support.
faq.q10: Where do I renew my plan?
faq.a10: Click "Renew plan" on the website (menu, price list) or open the plan screen in the app. The website takes you straight to the plan screen of the location you have open; only the owner can renew.
faq.q11: How can I pay for a plan?
faq.a11: By card, or by bank transfer when the app offers it to the salon. The renew button never charges by itself: you always see the price and confirm in the app.
faq.q12: What happens when my plan expires?
faq.a12: Your data stays. The app reminds you 2 days before. After expiry some features are locked until you renew, while checkout and invoices keep working.
faq.q13: I have several locations. Is that OK?
faq.a13: Yes. One owner account runs every location and switches from the menu. Each location has its own plan and end date.
faq.q14: Which languages does the app have?
faq.a14: The salon app is in Vietnamese, Czech, Slovak, English, German and French. The client booking page is in Czech, Slovak, English, German and French.
faq.q15: How do I send a marketing email to clients?
faq.a15: Go to Clients → Marketing, pick one of 10 occasion templates, edit the text, add an offer if you like, preview and send. It only reaches clients with an email who agreed to offers; one campaign per salon per day. Included in every plan.
faq.a16: Yes. EET 2.0 is mandatory in Czechia from 1 January 2027. In SalonGo you upload your certificate from DIS+, enter its password and the sales unit ID; after that every payment is reported automatically. EET is included in every plan.

sections.h: What is salon management software?
sections.p: Salon management software puts the salon's daily work in one place: taking bookings, scheduling staff, checkout, client records, revenue and payroll. Instead of a paper diary, spreadsheets and scattered messages, the owner opens the app and sees who is doing what today and how much came in. SalonGo is salon management software made for Vietnamese-run nail, hair, lash and beauty salons in Europe, used in the browser, on Windows and Mac computers and on phones.

sections.h: What should nail salon software do?
sections.p: Nail salons have several technicians, many short services, lots of regulars and tips. Good nail salon software should:
points: Give the salon its own online booking page where clients pick a service, a technician and a free time
Show a calendar per technician, so you see at a glance who is free
Take payments at the desk by cash, card or bank transfer and record tips
Calculate pay automatically as a percentage of revenue or a fixed salary, with tips shared the way the owner chooses
Report revenue by day, by technician and by service

sections.h: Online booking 24/7, no phone calls
sections.p: Each salon gets its own booking link for Facebook, Instagram or Google Maps. Clients book in Czech, Slovak, German, English or French, while the owner confirms and assigns staff in Vietnamese, in a single confirm box. The booking page only shows times when staff are free, so there are no double bookings, and clients with an email get a confirmation and a reminder 1 hour before.

sections.h: Front-desk checkout with automatic invoices
sections.p: Pick the service, the staff member and how the customer pays, and the invoice is done. Every payment goes straight into your revenue reports:
points: Cash, card, bank transfer: record how each customer paid, so the till matches at closing.
Every payment creates an invoice you can look up later.
Tips are recorded on the invoice and shared the way the owner chooses.

sections.h: Clear staff pay and tip sharing
sections.p: Each staff member has one pay type: a percentage of their own revenue (optionally per service) or a fixed monthly salary. Tips are recorded on the invoice; the owner chooses whether each tip goes to the technician the client tipped or all tips are split equally. At month end, open payroll and export.

sections.h: Keep regulars coming back with email marketing
sections.p: Clients → Marketing has 10 occasion templates such as Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day, Women's Day, Mother's Day and Black Friday. Edit a few lines, add a discount, preview and send to clients who agreed to offers. The app also flags client birthdays 2 days ahead so you can send wishes with an offer.

sections.h: Multiple locations, staff schedule on the phone
sections.p: One owner account runs every location, switches between them from the menu and sees all locations' revenue on one page. Staff have their own login on the phone and see their own appointments and, if the owner allows it, their own revenue.

points: Create a free account, enter the salon name and opening hours
Add staff, services, prices and how you pay staff
Share your booking link on Facebook, Instagram and Google
Stuck? Support answers in Vietnamese and Czech

guide2.h1: Salon and nail salon management software for Europe
guide2.intro: Bookings, checkout, EET, staff pay, tips and regular clients: what salon management software should do, and how SalonGo does it.

sections.h: What is salon management software?
body: Salon management software puts the salon's daily work in one place: taking bookings, scheduling staff, checkout, client records, revenue and payroll. Instead of a paper diary, spreadsheets and scattered messages, the owner opens the app and sees who is doing what today and how much came in.
SalonGo is salon management software made for Vietnamese-run nail, hair, lash and beauty salons in Europe. It runs in the browser on phones, iPads and computers, with apps for Mac and Windows.

sections.h: What should nail salon software do?
body: Nail salons have several technicians, many short services, lots of regulars and tips. Good nail salon software should:
points: Give the salon its own online booking page where clients pick a service, a technician and a free time
Show a calendar per technician, so you see at a glance who is free
Take payments at the desk by cash, card or bank transfer and record tips
Calculate pay automatically as a percentage of revenue or a fixed salary, with tips shared the way the owner chooses
Report revenue by day, by technician and by service

sections.h: Online booking 24/7, no phone calls
body: Each salon gets its own booking link for Facebook, Instagram or Google Maps. Clients book in Czech, Slovak, German, English or French, while the owner confirms and assigns staff in one box.
The booking page only shows times when staff are free, so there are no double bookings. Clients with an email get a confirmation and a reminder 1 hour before.
sections.figure: The salon's online booking page: the client picks a day and a free time

sections.h: Front-desk checkout with automatic receipts
body: Pick the service, the staff member and how the client pays, and the receipt is done. Every payment goes straight into your revenue reports:
points: Cash, card or bank transfer by QR code with the amount filled in, so the till matches at closing
Every payment creates a receipt, printed at 80 mm and easy to find later
Tips are recorded on the receipt and shared the way the owner chooses

sections.h: EET 2.0 from 1 January 2027: what salons need
body: From 1 January 2027, every cash or card payment in Czechia must be reported to the tax office. With SalonGo you don't need a separate till or extra software.

Upload the certificate from the DIS+ portal and enter the password and the shop ID in the app. From then on every receipt is sent to EET and printed with its FIK code. EET is in every plan, including the Chair plan, at no extra cost.

sections.h: Salon income and expenses: know your profit
body: The income tab adds up revenue from receipts by itself. The expenses tab records stock, rent and the like: amount, date, payment method and a short note. Income minus expenses shows straight away for each location, and you can export it to CSV, Excel or PDF for your accountant.
sections.figure: Income and expenses in SalonGo: income from receipts and salon expenses

sections.h: Clear staff pay and tip sharing
body: Each staff member has one pay type: a percentage of their own revenue (optionally per service) or a fixed monthly salary. The owner chooses whether each tip goes to the person the client tipped or all tips are split equally. At month end, open payroll and export.

sections.h: Keep regulars coming back with email marketing
body: Clients has 10 occasion templates such as Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day, Women's Day, Mother's Day and Black Friday. Edit a few lines, add a discount, preview and send to clients who agreed to offers. The app also flags client birthdays 2 days ahead so you can send wishes with an offer.

sections.h: Multiple locations, staff schedule on the phone
body: One owner account runs every location, switches between them from the menu and sees all locations' revenue on one page. Staff have their own login on the phone and see their own appointments and, if the owner allows it, their own revenue.
